description: Edge Side Include injection — inject ESI tags processed by reverse-proxy cache layers (Varnish, Akamai, Squid, Fastly)

basic_include.description: Inject ESI include tags to fetch arbitrary resources through the cache layer

probes.description: Basic ESI include tag. If the proxy processes it, the server receives a sub-request to /esi-test-RAND.
ESI include with external URL. A DNS or HTTP callback proves the cache layer processes ESI tags.
ESI include with XSS-style prefix to escape HTML context before the tag.

variable_access.description: ESI variable access to exfiltrate cookies, headers, or query params through the cache layer

probes.description: ESI vars tag to reflect session cookies. If processed, the response body contains the raw cookie header.
ESI vars to reflect the Host header. Verifies the proxy processes ESI variable substitution.
ESI vars to reflect query string. Useful to confirm ESI processing without external callbacks.

conditional.description: ESI conditional logic to leak information or branch cache behaviour

probes.description: Conditional ESI: if session cookie exists, exfiltrate it to collaborator.

xss_via_esi.description: XSS through ESI tag injection — inject script via ESI include of attacker-controlled resource

probes.description: ESI include with data: URI containing script. Some ESI processors support data URIs.
ESI inline tag stores content on the cache layer, making it fetchable at /attack.html.
